subject.title: Feature request: MEMORY.md size warning/limit enforcement

question: Should this issue ship warning-only Control UI visibility first, or also include hard MEMORY.md save refusal and auto-archive in this scope?
rationale: Current main has partial diagnostics, but blocking saves and moving memory content change user editing and recovery semantics beyond a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Ship warning-only first
options.body: Add a Control UI MEMORY.md size/budget indicator and near-limit warning while leaving saves allowed.

options.title: Block oversized saves
options.body: Make the UI or agents.files.set refuse over-budget MEMORY.md saves with an explicit override or recovery path.

options.title: Design archive separately
options.body: Treat auto-archive as a separate memory persistence feature with pointers, undo, and doctor or recovery integration.

recommendation.title: Ship warning-only first
recommendation.body: Add a Control UI MEMORY.md size/budget indicator and near-limit warning while leaving saves allowed.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision spans the gateway agent-files RPC contract and Control UI product behavior, where this history has the strongest available routing signal.
